currentPublicConfiguration.source: Separate current public app metadata inspection by wallet reviewer; no credentials/account data

limitations: The first observer ignored public metadata/CAPTCHA and unknown provider paths. Missing labels do not establish zero provider activity.
Cloudflare documents that automation browsers may be detected; ordinary-browser success supports an environment difference but does not prove the first failure cause.
Human signup success is not Google, passkey enrollment, recovery, exactly-once provisioning, all code-lifecycle scenarios, wallet recovery, full device/WCAG or financial acceptance.
No screenshots, DOM dump, request/response bodies, credentials, codes, recipient or private account identifiers are archived.
